caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular woven rug with a multicolored braided border comprised of interlaced blue, pink, tan, and brown hues. Inside the border, the rug is divided into several geometric sections, including rectangles, triangles, and parallelograms, with a symmetrical arrangement. The central area features a large outlined medallion shape, filled with a stylized six-petal flower motif; the petals alternate in shades of light blue and light brown with pink and tan outlines, and are set against a brown-tan background. Surrounding this central medallion are alternating linear and diagonal patterns in soft, muted colors—primarily cream, tan, blue, brown, and muted pink—with each geometric section containing different striped or block-pattern combinations. The overall color scheme is subdued, with a predominance of beige and pastel tones, and the entire composition is based on repetitive linear and floral motifs.
title: Shirred Rug
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
